name: local-codex
description: >- Launches and manages the local OpenAI Codex CLI as a non-interactive coding sub-agent via ChatGPT OAuth, never API keys. Use to delegate coding tasks to Codex, run codex exec, generate or refactor code, or get a Codex code review; phrases like 'codex', 'run codex', 'codex exec', 'delegate to codex'. Also route here for shared app-server daemon lifecycle and fault recovery: daemon restart, Codex hooks or spawns failing with 'Too many open files', fd exhaustion diagnostics; phrases like 'codex
